summary: Scalar deleting-destructor wrapper (MSVC pattern): always runs the object teardown via ShortComputation_6140(this), then, when the low bit of flag a2 is set, frees the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf(this). Returns this. The a2 & 1 test is the standard compiler-generated deleting-destructor 'free memory' flag; the function itself contains no field or global access.

operations.description: Invoke ShortComputation_6140(this) unconditionally as the object teardown body.
Test whether the low bit of the deleting-destructor flag is set: (a2 & 1) != 0.
When the flag bit is set, call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to free the object allocation.
Return this as the result of the wrapper.

unresolved: The concrete teardown performed by ShortComputation_6140 and the object's class/type are not evidenced by this packet.
a2 higher bits (only bit 0 is tested here) may carry other deleting-destructor flags for callers that pass them.
FreeWrapper_7bcf is a decompiler-named allocator; whether it is the global operator delete is not evidenced here.
